subject.title: perf(ci): O(1) boundary sticky key and 32 vCPU for the ext-package-boundary lane

question: Should the extension-boundary lane adopt the repository-wide sticky snapshot and permanent 32-vCPU allocation only after completed exact-head and first-warm-consumer timing evidence is available?
rationale: The code guards establish the intended topology, but CI cost, capacity, and shared-cache rollout safety require maintainer acceptance based on observed production workflow timings.

options.title: Wait for rollout proof
options.body: Update the CI documentation and require a completed exact-head cold run plus protected-writer and subsequent warm-consumer timings before merge.

options.title: Accept staged operational risk
options.body: Merge after the documentation fix and monitor the first main writer and warm PR consumer, accepting that the performance and shared-cache behavior are not proven beforehand.

recommendation.title: Wait for rollout proof
recommendation.body: Update the CI documentation and require a completed exact-head cold run plus protected-writer and subsequent warm-consumer timings before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged predecessor and this follow-up show direct ownership of the O(1) sticky-disk rollout and its performance measurements.
